theme.title: Across the NBA
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1983–84 Suns win?
questions.context: Phoenix · sixth seed · surprise West finalists
questions.note: 41 wins before their deep playoff run.

funFacts.text: Larry Nance won the first NBA Slam Dunk Contest that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Larry Nance competed in the inaugural NBA Slam Dunk Contest

funFacts.text: Phoenix played at Arizona Veterans Memorial Coliseum.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Arena | Arizona Veterans Memorial Coliseum

funFacts.text: Walter Davis earned another Western Conference All-Star selection.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: In Game 3 of the 1989 Finals, Joe Dumars scored how many points in a row in the third quarter?
questions.context: 1989 NBA Finals · Game 3 · at Los Angeles
questions.note: 17 in a row, on his way to 31.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Joe Dumars scored 31 points, scoring 17 consecutive points in the third quarter

funFacts.text: Magic Johnson left the third Finals game after only a few minutes because of injury.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Magic Johnson missed most of Game 3 due to injury, exiting after five minutes

funFacts.text: Dennis Rodman hauled in 19 rebounds in the game despite battling back spasms.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dennis Rodman, despite having back spasms, had 19 rebounds

funFacts.text: The Pistons had swept both Boston and Milwaukee before battling Michael Jordan's Bulls.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: sweeping both the Boston Celtics and the Milwaukee Bucks

questions.prompt: What did David Robinson average in rebounds in the 1999 Finals?
questions.note: 11.8 rebounds a night during San Antonio's first championship.

funFacts.text: Robinson partnered with Tim Duncan in their second season as the Twin Towers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1998–99 season was the second season of the "Twin Towers" pairing

funFacts.text: Robinson also finished in the top group of regular-season MVP voting that year.

funFacts.text: The Spurs swept both the Lakers and Portland on their way to the Finals.

questions.prompt: How many road games did the 1995–96 Bulls win?
questions.note: 33, the most ever until the 2015–16 Warriors won 34.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their 33 road wins were the most in NBA history until the 2015–16 Warriors won 34 road games.

funFacts.text: Golden State eventually surpassed Chicago's road-win mark during the 2015–16 campaign.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 2015–16 Warriors won 34 road games

funFacts.text: The Bulls became the first team to exceed 70 regular-season wins and also take the championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the only team in NBA history to win more than 70 games and an NBA title in the same season

funFacts.text: Chicago entered the All-Star break with a 42–5 record after a blistering first half of the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: held a 42–5 record at the All-Star break

questions.prompt: When Trae Young stunned Milwaukee in the 2021 East finals opener, how many points did he score?
questions.context: Trae Young · Hawks at Bucks · June 2021

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
